task.blueprint.build.desc: When holding an anchored blueprint, the maid takes materials from nearby containers first, and falls back to the warehouse marked by her binding book.
task.blueprint.study.desc: Follows you around and records whatever you craft by hand into her study pool
task.blueprint.industry.desc: Works through the orders placed in her study pool: fetches materials from storage, crafts them by hand, and only during her working hours
gui.blueprint.study.title: Study Pool
gui.blueprint.study.empty: She has not learned anything yet
gui.blueprint.study.pick_hint: Click a product on the left to see how she makes it
gui.blueprint.study.help.pick: Left-click a product: her recipes, click again to cycle
gui.blueprint.study.help.uses: Right-click a product or one of its ingredients: what it can be used for
gui.blueprint.study.help.cell: An ingredient in the layout: left jumps to its recipe, and she will tell you if she has not learned it
gui.blueprint.study.help.drill: In the uses panel you can keep going: left jumps there, right asks for its own uses
gui.blueprint.study.help.forget: Shift+left-click a product: forget it (and its recipes)
gui.blueprint.study.help.order: Ordering switches her to Industry mode; she works only in her working hours
gui.blueprint.study.help.search: The search box filters by name or item id
gui.blueprint.study.no_recipe: Only the product was seen, not the recipe (demo it again)
gui.blueprint.study.off_duty: (she is off duty, waiting for her working hours)
message.blueprint.study.forgotten: I have forgotten how to make %s
message.blueprint.study.not_learned: I have not learned how to make this yet
message.blueprint.craft.order_full: That order is already at the limit
message.blueprint.craft.off_duty: It is not my working time yet — I will start when my shift begins
message.blueprint.craft.off_work_pending: Shift's over for today! I will finish the rest next shift
message.blueprint.craft.no_recipe: I do not know how to make %s, so I cannot do this order
message.blueprint.craft.no_book: I do not carry a binding book, so the marked warehouse is out of reach (put the book in my bauble slot or backpack)
message.blueprint.craft.backpack_full: My backpack cannot hold the materials for %s
message.blueprint.craft.make_failed: The recipe did not match, nothing was made (no material taken)
message.blueprint.craft.recipe_loop: Making %1$s needs %2$s, and making %2$s needs %1$s again — that loops back on itself, I cannot finish it
message.blueprint.no_schematic: This blueprint is empty. Right-click two blocks to select an area
message.blueprint.already_has_schematic: This blueprint already contains a structure
message.blueprint.schematic_missing: The structure data for this blueprint is missing
message.blueprint.cleared: Blueprint cleared, ready to record again
message.blueprint.maid_no_material: I cannot find the materials for the build
message.blueprint.maid_need_tool: I cannot break the %s — it needs a proper tool, so I will leave it for now
message.blueprint.maid_unbreakable: I cannot touch the %s — it is not something that can be broken, so I will leave it for now
message.blueprint.maid_build_leftover: Built, though %s blocks could not be placed (usually missing support or the spot is taken) - re-anchor to try again
message.blueprint.maid_empty_blueprint: The blueprint in my hand is empty — record a structure first
message.blueprint.maid_no_anchor: The blueprint has no anchor — right-click a block with it first
message.blueprint.maid_forbidden: This blueprint does not allow me to build
message.blueprint.maid_no_schematic: The structure data for this blueprint is missing
message.blueprint.maid_unreachable: I cannot reach the build site — shrink the range or move me closer
message.blueprint.maid_no_backpack: I have no usable backpack to carry materials
message.blueprint.maid_backpack_full: I reached the container, but my backpack cannot hold the missing materials: %s
message.blueprint.maid_source_empty: I reached the container, but it holds nothing I still need: %s
message.blueprint.maid_return_no_target: I want to return the leftover materials but found no container nearby to hold them
message.blueprint.maid_return_failed: The container cannot hold the leftover materials — I will keep them for now
message.blueprint.maid_return_unreachabl: I cannot reach the return target — the leftover materials stay with me
message.blueprint.maid_bound_other_dimen: The bound container is in another dimension — I cannot get there
message.blueprint.maid_bound_empty: The bound container no longer holds the materials I need: %s
message.blueprint.highlight_other_dimens: The bound target is in another dimension — not visible here
message.blueprint.highlight_not_loaded: The chunk with the bound target is not loaded yet — move closer and try again
message.blueprint.terminal_not_ready: The Maid Terminal is not connected to an ME network — place it right next to a cable or another AE device
message.blueprint.terminal_not_connected: No AE device is attached to the Maid Terminal — place it against a cable or machine
message.blueprint.terminal_no_network: The Maid Terminal is not linked to any ME network
message.blueprint.terminal_no_power: The ME network has no power — the Maid Terminal cannot run
message.blueprint.terminal_no_channel: The ME network is out of channels for the Maid Terminal
message.blueprint.creative_interface_off: The Creative Maid Interface is not on an ME network, so its AE side is inactive — maids can still take items from it directly
schematic.side_too_large: The selected area is too large
schematic.volume_too_large: The selected area is too large

tooltip.blueprint.binding_book_hint_clea: Shift + right-click a block to unbind
tooltip.blueprint.binding_book_bauble: Fits in a maid's bauble slot as a backup warehouse

tooltip.blueprint.wireless_hint_bind: Place it in an ME Wireless Access Point to link
